test_title: PYST 73: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, N, O and P are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

No one sits to the right of B. Only three people sit between B and N. Only two people sit between N and C. A sits third to the left of D. O sits to the immediate right of D.

How many people sit between P and C?
solution:
Given: Seven people C, A, P, N, D, O and B are sitting in a row facing north.

No one sits to the right of B.

Only three people sit between B and N.

Only two people sit between N and C.

A sits third to the left of D.

O sits to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e747ed8726e2a9cbd0327801ea7a5c2b4ec862548e334a4bffdd53d17c1901d8.png] 

Now, people between C and P = 4 people.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
